title: Bahmani Economy
definition: The Bahmani economy was a centralized agrarian-based system characterized by the 'Tarafdari' administrative structure, heavy reliance on land revenue, and significant maritime trade through the Konkan ports.
importanceInUpsc: Essential for understanding the socio-economic evolution of the Deccan, the transition from feudal to centralized administrative structures, and the geopolitical significance of trade routes in Medieval India.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Bahmani Economy.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Core foundational concepts of Medieval Indian Administration
Geographical understanding of the Deccan Plateau
